observations.title: Stromboli volcano (Italy)
observations.description: The Sezione di Catania - Osservatorio Etneo (INGV) reported that eruptive activity continued at Stromboli during 5-11 October. Webcam images showed Strombolian activity from vents in Area N within the upper part of the Sciara del Fuoco, and vents in Area C-S (South-Central Crater) on the crater terrace. Explosions at Area N ejected lapilli and bombs above the vents and explosions at Area C-S ejected both fine and coarse tephra above the vents. The daily frequency of explosions at both vents was at medium level and the intensity of the explosions was generally at low levels. Lava overflowed vent N1 in Area N at 1505 on 5 October and ended at 0050 on 6 October. The lava flow descended the upper part of the Sciara del Fuoco. A second overflow occurred later that morning during approximately 0925-1040. The Alert Level remained at Yellow (the second lowest level on a four-level scale) according to the Dipartimento della Protezione Civile. Sources: Dipartimento della Protezione Civile,Sezione di Catania - Osservatorio Etneo (INGV)
